notes.title: Update 27: Optimization Settings, New Reloadable Weapons, Props, Secret Levels?
notes.content: [h2][u][b]Change log[/b][/u][/h2][p][/p][p][u][b]Optimization[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Level optimizations to improve performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Spawn Density setting: Sets amount of default AI spawns: "Low" reduces total spawns from existing spawners if toggled before entering the level, increasing performance[/p][/*][*][p]Dead Body Despawn frequency setting: 5,15,30,60 seconds or never.[/p][/*][*][p]Additional Tracer settings: Tracers can be set to On, Off (entirely even for the player), or Player Only[/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]New Reloadable Weapons[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]When you find a secret weapon, it will unlock its reloadable variant in the spawn menu.,[/p][/*][*][p]New reloadable weapons added: Commonwealth AR \[STG 44], Commonwealth Battle Rifle, Equalizer, Famas, Imperial Clobber, Imperial Hozer, Imperial Seer, MP5, Ouroboros, P90, PPSH, Remembrance Auto Shotgun, Republic Heavy Rifle, RPD, SMG Makeshift, Sniper \[Remington],[/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]New Props[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Soldier-scale furniture props: Chairs, Bench, and Table.[/p][/*][*][p]Geometry Props: Triangle, Wedges, Cylinders.[/p][/*][*][p]3 large Rocks: Flat, Smooth, and Jagged rock.[/p][/*][*][p]B17 Bomber, F4 phantom, Plastic Box + Lid, Bucket, Cassette + Player, Cardboard Box, 2 Book variants, Plastic Refueling Station/Gas Tank.[/p][/*][*][p]A third plastic House option![/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]Prop Freeze Gun & Prop Mover Gun[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Freeze props to lock objects in place with the Prop Freeze gun,[/p][/*][*][p]Unfreeze the props when you want them to be dynamic,[/p][/*][*][p]Freeze Prop gun added to the weapons menu,[/p][/*][*][p]Prop Mover gun can now move frozen props!,[/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]Additional Updates[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Save map system more robust with Corruption detection.[/p][/*][*][p]A strange device has appeared in the City Diorama map... [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Check out the Youtube trailer for this update here![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X5riP_T5LX4"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Next up: Conquest 2.0 Overhaul, continued optimizations and improvements, and Multiplayer[/p][p][/p][p]Let us know what you think of the update and what you're hoping to see! - PBG Team[/p]

notes.title: Coming Up Next: Sneak Peak For The Next Update!
notes.content:
[p][b][i][u]More stuff! More frames![/u][/i][/b]

We’ve been a bit tied up with a number of things so the update took longer than we anticipated, but we're now back at our usual pace!  
Thanks to the feedback you've all provided us, we're continuously finding ways to improve the game and add community requested features!

Here's what to look forward to in the next update:

[b]Optimizations:[/b]
First pass of optimization for certain levels like the Garden Trenches, Beachfront, Kitchen, City Diorama, and Attic![/p][p]We're also adding more settings to help with optimization such as dead body duration and spawn density settings you can change before loading into levels.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Props:[/b]  -3 Large Rock types (Flat, Round, Jagged) to help make more natural terrain!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343382/01e8da801873d335e4d078d553052776afd8c812.png"][/img]-A third House prop! Simple, Squared, and Performance-friendly!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343382/e244f9a4e71c305a5657f541e036ad5a260b7728.png"][/img]-Interior Plastic Props! 2 Chairs, a Bench, and a Table!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343382/f7ff1f97e63880124cad85d40173b37283cdf138.png"][/img][b]More[/b] [b]Reloadable Weapons Variants:[/b]  Commonwealth Assault Rifle, Commonwealth Battle Rifle, Equalizer, FAMAS, Imperial Clobber, Imperial Hozer, Imperial Seer, MP5, Ouroboros, P90, PPSH, Remembrance, Auto Shotgun, SCAR, RPD, Makeshift SMG, Remington Sniper, Thompson, Vulcan  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343382/7c71e135b52e4264527b299954ae38031d8cd8de.png"][/img]          [/p][p][b]Some secrets..[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343382/35f8a792cd3b227389c00511c97c13e68b4410a7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]And more.. [/b]stay tuned for the upcoming update![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 26, Build 249, 07/26/2025
notes.content:
[h2][u][b]Change log[/b][/u][/h2][p][u][b]
Prop Freezing[/b][/u] [/p][list][*][p][b]Props can be frozen: [/b]Pick up a prop in big mode and hold Trigger to Freeze the prop which will make it immovable even in air. When held the prop can clip through objects allowing for flexible placement. Hold Trigger on them to unfreeze them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Immovable spawned props like the houses, watch tower, bunkers, can be picked up in big mode and when let go will freeze in their new spot.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p] [u]Player Spawn:[/u] [/p][list][*][p]You're now able to place Player Spawn locations (found in Support and Props/Level Design) so you can respawn or start at custom locations on your levels.[/p][/*][/list][p][u]Spawnable Artillery Beacon:[/u] [/p][list][*][p]Randomly drops artillery around the map for the ambience.[/p][/*][*][p]Found under the Support category.[/p][/*][/list][p] [u]New Settings:[/u] [/p][list][*][p]Able to toggle crouch controls off: useful especially for those with joystick drift.[/p][/*][*][p]Toggle Grab.[/p][/*][*][p]Joystick Movement Controls Swap: able to switch movement inputs between the two joysticks, also useful for joystick drift mitigation.[/p][/*][/list][p] [u]Fixes:[/u] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed enemy soldiers spawning at friendly flags in Conquest mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Lee Enfield grip.[/p][/*][/list][p]Dev Note: The Steam version of Plastic Battlegrounds actually released on the newest experimental build at the time (Build 242, first half of Update 26) early - C4, Medkits, syringes, etc. were all actually only available to testers on the Quest but all players on PCVR up until this weekend! This Steam update that launches alongside the Quest update now puts them both on the same version, hope you enjoyed getting to play with the new toys early![/p][p][/p][p]More optimizations, gun handling, and platform specific fixes are coming in addition to content and feature additions. Remember to give any feedback or notes to us, we read them all![/p]

notes.title: Update 26-S8, Build 244, 07/17/2025
notes.content:
[p][b][u]Change log[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]-[b]Adjusted handling characteristics for Index users[/b]. We're hoping it solves the issue of players needing to hold their controllers at awkward angles. Please let us know below if you're still having problems, but doubly confirm you're on the right version of the game! (Should say "Update 26-S8, Build 244" on the Main Menu level.)[/p][p]
-[b]Added Graphics settings![/b] The game was set to high quality by default but will now set itself to something a bit lower. You can find them in the [u]Settings[/u] menu under [u]Performance[/u]!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343382/ab980e02ebbda30462ac2daeb4591e824f1ce0bb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]-[b]Trigger can now be used to grab magazines, slides, and grenade pins![/b] You'll now be able to interact with weapon functions without accidentally grabbing other guns or grab points. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343382/a38ffdbd5adc198f8c9028b7add426fad095b58a.png"][/img][/p][p][u]Smaller Changes:[/u][/p][list][*][p]Added Secrets tutorial to Bootcamp[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u]Fixes and Adjustments[/u][/p][list][*][p]Fixed no audio bug [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Scoped Python not unlocking[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced floppiness of some weapons especially the bazooka[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tanks being launched into the air from bazooka shots  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual bug where distant AI Soldiers would stutter back and forth when moving.  [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][u]Developer Notes[/u][/p][p][/p][p]We are noting down ALL feedback you've given us so far since release. Many more improvements, features, optimization and fixes to come - it's the early days of Plastic Battlegrounds. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your support and if you have any questions or comments, we will note down or respond to basically all of them because we love working with the community to make this game the best it can be![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Graphics Settings, Performance, and Index Gun Handling
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello, soldiers![/b]  

Our team is currently prioritizing performance and will be adding graphics settings in an upcoming patch!  We know a lot of it is coming from particles and setting them to be lower will help a lot. 
 
 We're also looking into the Valve Index gun handling and aim to make it feel much more ergonomic and natural to use.   

Thank you to those who've highlighted issues and sent feedback our way! We've noted every concern that players have reported! 
Your support has set our morale to an all-time high and we can't wait to get updates into your hands!

Please continue asking questions and reporting feedback whenever you'd like in the steam discussion posts, here in this thread, or Discord! We will get right on it![/p]

notes.title: Addressing The No Sound Bug + Fix Coming In Patch!
notes.content:
[p]We seem to have a bug where sound doesn’t play on some headsets.  

[b]A few players have found a temporary fix for this by bringing the game window into focus on the desktop.[/b]    

If you're experiencing this problem please let us know by commenting which headset you use in this thread! 
It'll help us pin down what's causing it and we'll notify you when the upcoming patch resolves the issue. 

Stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: PCVR CLOSED TESTING

notes.title: Progress Update on the Steam Release
notes.content:
[b]Hello!
[/b]
This marks our first PBG Steam announcement! 

We wanted to inform those who may not have heard over on our Discord that the PCVR build of PBG is taking longer than we initially expected. Every headset has it's own unique quirks, complexities, and bugs that we're working our way through. 

Rest assured, we are making steady progress and as soon as we have a estimated release date we will make another announcement. Stay tuned!

Cody - from the Plastic Battlegrounds Team
